opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn round

amount.raw: Maximum grant available up to £20,000 (research and travel up to £2,500)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non‑profit organisations for projects (exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conferences, publications, long‑term research) and individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) for research and travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Grants support exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, collections, conferences, publications, long‑term research and research‑and‑travel for individuals, to develop sculpture and its appreciation.
